working_definition: Fer2-negative remainder of the parent dopaminergic cluster (Davie et al. 2018, res-2.0 cluster 42; 125 cells) after the PAM (Fer2-positive) subcluster was split out. Represents an unresolved mixture of the ~7 non-PAM dopaminergic neuron groups of the adult central brain (PPL1, PPL2ab, PPM1/2, PPM3, PAL etc.), sharing a canonical dopaminergic marker signature (DAT, ple, Vmat, Ddc) but not further separated transcriptomically.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any dopaminergic neuron of the adult.

justification: Per dataset guidance, this is a 'remainder' label (cells of the dopaminergic class not resolved to a subtype after PAM was pulled out) and the correct honest mapping level is the class term itself, not any of the individually-named DAN clusters (PPL1, PPL2ab, PPM1/2, PPM3, PAL) it mixes. FBbt:00058206 'adult dopaminergic neuron' is exactly this class-level term restricted to adult tissue, matching the report's central-brain, adult, dopamine-releasing description. Note this term is broader than the true underlying biology (~7 named DAN clusters) but that breadth is honest given the atlas provides no further resolution.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any neuron that is capable of some dopamine secretion, neurotransmission.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Life-stage-unspecified parent; adult-specific FBbt:00058206 better matches the confirmed adult (0-50 day) tissue.

recommendation: Accept adult dopaminergic neuron (FBbt:00058206) as the honest class-level mapping for this non-PAM dopaminergic remainder; do not assign any individual DAN cluster term.
